svg.title: Memory: the tabs agents leave behind
svg.desc: On a real Mac, the daemon had run 67 hours with 49 tabs agents had opened and never closed: 17.4 GB and 90% of a CPU core. Tabs now rest when unused (hidden after 5 minutes, closed after 15) and the back-forward cache is off. With one agent still working and ten others gone, memory once they had left fell from 2,756 to 331 MB (8.3×) and their CPU from 15.3 to 1.9 seconds a minute. When each of six tabs had visited four pages, memory fell from 3,863 to 312 MB (12.4×). The pages are synthetic and local; command latency was unchanged.
